Remote English Teaching Opportunity
subtitle: TeachFromHome Application

items.title: About the Job / O poslu
items.text: Fully remote online teaching position with flexible scheduling, international students, and long-term collaboration potential. Work from anywhere, build stable monthly income, and grow your teaching skills with structured support. / Potpuno remote pozicija online predavaca sa fleksibilnim rasporedom, internacionalnim ucenicima i dugorocnom saradnjom. Radi odakle zelis, izgradi stabilan mesecni prihod i unapredi predavacke vestine uz podrsku.

items.title: Requirements / Uslovi
items.text: Fluent English, clear American or British accent preferred, professional communication, reliable internet, and a quiet teaching setup. Teaching experience is a plus. We are reviewing applications daily and hiring serious candidates ready to start soon. / Potreban je tecan engleski, pozeljan jasan americki ili britanski akcenat, profesionalna komunikacija, stabilan internet i mirno okruzenje za rad. Iskustvo je plus. Prijave se pregledaju svakodnevno.
